title: Bot memory fact
description: Fact (Fact): a verified record about the farm in memory of the bot scope (MEM-6). The model proposes only the kind, the predicate and the subject ($defs/proposal, at most 3 per attempt, $defs/proposals); the predicate sets the window and the selection rule, the core collects the evidence and computes the value. The data_mark equals the highest mark of the evidence and is not above the ceiling of the space. A fact from an attempt with untrusted_seen gets untrusted_origin: true. Only the core writes it at complete in the same transaction; a space holds at most 100 active facts.

tenant.description: Tenant; a fact does not cross tenants (GOV-16).

space.description: Memory space; the core computes it (MEM-1). The holder of the farm manager seat has a separate space in each tenant (MGR-27).

type.description: Subject kind: a catalog resource, task type, dataset or schedule of this tenant. An identity, a seat, a principal or a proposal is never a subject.

id.description: Object id from the restricted character set [a-z0-9:_.-]{1,64}: catalog name, resource, task type, worker, task.

on.description: The resource on which the task type runs (for example the machine db1), if the predicate distinguishes it.

value.description: The value the core computed: a number, a resource id or a code.

unit.description: Unit of the value from the predicate, for example min or d.

window.description: The window that the predicate sets.

evidence.description: Evidence that the core collected by the predicate rule: objects of the same tenant, not erased and accessible to the role of the space owner.

derivation.description: Predicate derivation with a version, for example task.duration.p95_min@1.

untrusted_origin.description: The author attempt saw untrusted text; tasks with the purposes review and manage get only facts with false.

inherited.description: For a copy taken by a successor (MEM-8); the model does not see whom the fact came from.

from_bot.description: The identity that retired or changed its binding.

data_mark.description: The highest mark of the evidence, not above the ceiling of the space; the fact gets only into a task with a mark not lower.

personal_seen.description: The personal_seen flag of the author attempt (AUD-5).

uses.description: How many times the fact was inserted into a task.

last_used_at.description: Last read; on overflow the fact with the oldest last_used_at is evicted.

bot_epoch.description: Binding epoch of the author attempt.

type.description: Subject kind: a catalog resource, task type, dataset or schedule of this tenant. An identity, a seat, a principal or a proposal is never a subject.

id.description: Object id from the restricted character set [a-z0-9:_.-]{1,64}: catalog name, resource, task type, worker, task.

on.description: The resource on which the task type runs (for example the machine db1), if the predicate distinguishes it.

proposal.description: A fact proposal by the model in the attempt result: only the kind, the predicate and the subject. The schema rejects window, evidence and value fields (MEM-6).

proposals.description: The facts field of the result of an attempt of a type with memory.facts: propose: at most memory.facts.per_attempt (3) triples.
